# T for Conspiracy Factory

T for Conspiracy Factory is an AI-powered merchandise concept platform.

Purpose:
Generate satirical t-shirt concepts based on internet conspiracy theories.

Workflow:
WhatsApp → OpenClaw → Mira → API → Neon → Dashboard

Core technologies:
- Next.js
- Prisma
- Neon Postgres
- OpenClaw
- GPT-5.5
- WhatsApp
- Tailscale

Pages:
- / : Dashboard
- /concepts : Concept library
- /topics : Topic overview

Concept schema:
- topic
- slogan
- description
- prompt
- score
- status
